metadata.clan_summary:
[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC bob-cli-lr[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Multi-calendar gcal sync with calendar marks, starting with [/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]         [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Birthdays[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]`bob gcal sync` syncs several Google Calendars from one account, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]chosen by id. Every row from a non-primary calendar starts its [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]title with that calendar's configured mark, so `- **all day** 🎂 [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]Ava's Birthday [📅](…)` lands in 2026/20261114.md and the source [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]calendar is clear in the note, every CLI surface, and JSON. [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]Removing a calendar from config freezes its old rows instead of [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]cancelling them.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]6[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]5[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]plan:202611/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]gcal_calendar_marks.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim] Prompt: [#87AFFF][/dim]prompts/202611/gcal_calendar_marks.md[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Bead: [#87AFFF][/dim]bob-cli-lr[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Page: [#87AFFF][/dim]https://github.com/bobs-org/bob-cli--beads/blob/main/pages/bob-cli-lr/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]README.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Calendar marks in config, a resolved calendar set, and [/bold #D7AFFF]       [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]per-calendar fake gog[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]calendar-config[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]calendar-config: add the required, validated `mark` key to [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`gcal.calendars`, check the calendar set against the account's calendar [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]list before any fetch (missing calendars, primary/email aliases, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]unmarked non-primary), carry a resolved calendar identity on every [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]snapshot event, and teach the test fake gog to serve events and lookups [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]per calendar.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Marked titles in the daily note[/bold #D7AFFF]                               [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]marked-rows[dim] · [dim][/dim]after calendar-config[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]marked-rows: render the mark at the front of the Google-owned title span[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]through one shared helper used for rendering and journal span hashes. [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]New rows are born marked; untouched rows follow mark changes in place; [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]hand-edited titles are kept and reported once; block ids and probes stay[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]on the bare title.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Freeze rows from calendars that left the config[/bold #D7AFFF]               [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]deconfigured-freeze[dim] · [dim][/dim]after calendar-config[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]deconfigured-freeze: journaled rows whose calendar is no longer [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]configured are left alone, reported once, and never looked up, which [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]removes the false Moved and Deleted verdicts; re-adding the calendar [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]resumes the same identities.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Calendar identity on every CLI surface and in JSON[/bold #D7AFFF]            [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]calendar-surfaces[dim] · [dim][/dim]after marked-rows[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]calendar-surfaces: show marks and the sync set in `bob gcal calendars`, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`list`, `sync`, `doctor`, and the ack and note human lines; add additive[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`mark` and `calendar` JSON fields; update the gcal and JSON reference [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]docs.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Decision record, setup guide, and the Birthdays config row[/bold #D7AFFF]    [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]enable-birthdays[dim] · [dim][/dim]after calendar-surfaces, deconfigured-freeze[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]enable-birthdays: write the calendar-mark decision record, add the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]add-another-calendar step to the setup guide, enable the Birthdays [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]calendar by id with its mark in the chezmoi bob config, and record [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]follow-ups.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Install, apply, and prove Ava's birthday lands[/bold #D7AFFF]                [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]live-acceptance[dim] · [dim][/dim]after enable-birthdays[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]live-acceptance: install the new bob and apply the chezmoi config on the[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]hosts that hold the Google grant, then run doctor, calendars, list, a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]dry run, the real `-D yesterday` sync, and an idempotent rerun. Ava's [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]birthday must land as exactly one marked all-day bullet.[/#D7D7AF]
